name: Topic 42: Micronutrient needs by sex and life stage

rules.if: profile has sex, age 19-59 and no pregnancy or lactation flag
rules.then: use the adult male or adult female column of the master table (ICMR-NIN 2020 first); apply activity scaling only to thiamine, riboflavin, niacin and B6; label values (secondary, unverified)
show pregnancy column (iron 27 mg, folate 570 ug DFE, iodine 220 ug, calcium 1000 mg where found); for Not found rows show 'ask your doctor'; set requires_doctor_input; never recommend supplements
rules.source: ICMR-NIN 2020 (secondary, unverified); Anemia Mukt Bharat (MoHFW, secondary)

rules.then: show lactation column (calcium 1200 mg, folate 330 ug DFE, iodine 290 ug, vitamin C 115 mg where found); iron shows 'ask your doctor' because ICMR lactation iron was Not found; requires_doctor_input
rules.source: ICMR-NIN 2020 (secondary, unverified); Anemia Mukt Bharat (MoHFW, secondary)

rules.then: use calcium 1200 mg and iodine 150 ug (ICMR-NIN 2020 as tabulated in IJMR 2022); use the adult value for other nutrients labelled 'no separate 60+ value found'; use iron 19 mg (est.) for women; prompt B12, vitamin D, protein and fluids; supplements are requires_doctor_input
rules.source: ICMR-NIN 2020 (secondary, unverified); IJMR 2022 elderly status paper

rules.if: sex is female and age is 10 to 49
rules.then: add iron, folate and vitamin C pairing tips; show 'Many women and girls in India fall short of iron. Worth checking with your doctor.'; never state the user is anaemic
app does not yet support child or adolescent targets; show 'Not found: ICMR age-band values not confirmed' and advise a doctor or dietitian
rules.source: ICMR-NIN 2020 age bands Not found in this research

rules.if: values differ between files (potassium 3500 vs 3510, B12 2.5 vs 2.2, iodine 140 vs 150)
rules.then: use potassium 3510 mg, B12 2.2 ug, iodine 150 ug (ICMR-NIN first)

rules.if: a nutrient has no ICMR value for the user's group
rules.then: show adult value as 'reference only' or the named non-ICMR standard, with 'ask your doctor' for pregnancy, lactation and 60+

mergeMethod.rules: union (newest wording of the same rule)
